name: open
description: Open a URL in the QA browser and return a compact snapshot: one line per element, e.g. `e4 textbox "Email" [required]`. Shadow DOM content is inlined; iframes appear as indented `frame "…"` blocks. Refs (eN) can be used as targets in act. Starts recording a new tape for flow save.

fresh.description: New isolated context (clears cookies/storage). Default false.

device.description: Emulate a device, e.g. "iPhone 13", "Pixel 7", "iPad Mini". "" = back to desktop.

name: act
description: Run MANY steps in ONE call (fill a whole form, submit, assert) — this is what makes fastqa fast. Targets resolve by ref, label, placeholder, role+name or text — also inside open shadow DOM and iframes — so you usually do not need a snapshot first. Stops at the first failing step and then returns a full snapshot so you can recover. Otherwise returns only what changed on the page (+ added / - removed lines). expect_* steps are QA assertions that poll until they pass or time out. expect_request checks an API call happened with the right status, expect_no_errors fails on JS errors / 5xx since the batch started, expect_accessible runs a WCAG check.

target.description: ref "e5", visible text/label like "Log in" or "Email", or a selector: "#id", "css=..", "testid=..". expect_request: "POST /api/orders" or "/regex/". expect_no_errors: optional text to ignore.

value.description: text to fill, key to press, option to select, url, expected text/url (use /regex/ for regex). {{name}} reads env FASTQA_VAR_name so secrets never pass through the model. expect_request: status "200"/"2xx"/"<400". expect_no_errors: "strict" also fails on 4xx. expect_accessible: lowest failing impact, default "serious".

frame.description: only search inside this iframe (title, name, id or src fragment). Usually not needed: targets are searched in the page, shadow DOM and all iframes.

snapshot.description: What to return after the steps. Default diff.

name: snapshot
description: Compact page snapshot. mode=interactive (default): controls, headings, alerts. mode=full: also visible text. root=css to scope to part of the page.

name: screenshot
description: JPEG screenshot. Only use when layout/visuals matter — text snapshots are much cheaper.

name: audit
description: Accessibility check (axe-core, WCAG 2.1 A/AA) of the current page and its iframes. Returns violations grouped by impact.

name: evidence
description: JS errors, console errors/warnings and failed HTTP requests (>=400) collected since the last call. Use for bug reports.

name: flow
description: Record & replay without the model. start: begin a new recording tape. save: store the steps recorded since open/start as a named flow. run: replay a flow (or "*" for all) in an isolated context, no LLM calls, returns pass/fail per step. list / show: inspect flows. export: write a Playwright Test .spec.ts.

dataset.description: run: CSV file (or name in .fastqa/data/) — the flow runs once per row, columns fill {{placeholders}}
